WHAT HAPPENS NEXT?
Your onboarding starts here!

The sooner you complete this first step, the sooner we can begin these required checks.
Once your pre-employment screenings have been completed successfully, you will receive a text to book a short welcome video call, and your paid orientation and training link right after it.
If you have any questions along the way, we're happy to help. Just give our office a call at (417) 234-8494.
EMPLOYMENT RELATIONSHIP

Employment with Caring Companions is at will. This means that either you or the Company may end the employment relationship at any time, with or without notice, and with or without cause, as permitted by applicable law.
This offer will remain open for seven (7) business days from the date of this letter, through October 20, 2026. Your signing link expires at the same time.
We are excited about the opportunity to have you join the Caring Companions family and look forward to working with you!
Warmly,
Samantha Troutman, Co-Founder & CEO, Caring Companions In-Home Senior Care

Reports to: Care Coordinator / Lead Caregiver · FLSA status: Non-Exempt (Hourly) · Category: Field · Direct Care · Employment classification: PRN (as-needed) field caregiver
POSITION SUMMARY

The Caregiver provides non-medical, in-home care that helps clients remain safe, independent, and comfortable in their own homes. Working from each client's individualized care plan, the Caregiver delivers personal care, homemaker, companionship, and transportation support with compassion, reliability, and professionalism.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Follow each client's individualized care plan and complete all assigned care tasks.
Provide personal care such as bathing, dressing, grooming, oral hygiene, toileting and incontinence care, and feeding assistance when appropriate.
Assist with mobility, transfers, walking, and fall prevention using proper body mechanics.
Provide medication reminders (not medication administration).
Perform homemaker services including meal preparation, light housekeeping, laundry, and maintaining a clean, safe environment.
Provide companionship, conversation, and encouragement of social and physical activity.
Transport or accompany clients to appointments and approved errands when authorized by the care plan.
Observe and promptly report changes in the client's physical condition, mental status, safety, or environment.
Clock in and out using AxisCare Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) and complete accurate, timely documentation before the end of each shift.
Maintain professional boundaries and safeguard client property, privacy, and confidentiality.
QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS
Be at least 18 years of age.
Successfully pass all required background screenings.
Successful completion of any drug screening required by Caring Companions' screening policy.
Maintain a valid driver's license and current automobile insurance if transporting clients.
Possess reliable transportation and a working telephone.
Meet applicable licensing, certification, and training requirements.
Complete orientation, onboarding, dementia/Alzheimer's training, and annual in-service requirements.
Demonstrate compassion, dependability, and professionalism, and communicate effectively.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORKING CONDITIONS

Requires standing, walking, bending, and assisting with transfers; must be able to safely support client mobility and lift up to 50 pounds, where authorized, using proper body mechanics and equipment such as gait belts. Work is performed in clients' homes and may involve exposure to pets and varied household environments.
